rationale: Rejected for a substantive one-day error. The complete visually inspected GPO 1911 printed page 76/PDF89 authorizes the quarterly session on the 15th day of November, 1906, not November 16. Both permitted identity crosswalk rows identify the September 20, 1906 Roosevelt order by date and subject as EO:506 and agree on November 15. The claim reproduces the correct source quotation but repeatedly asserts November 16 as the authorized day and November 17 as first cessation. Its own source contradicts those assertions. On its stated fresh-scheduling-authority theory the named day remains available through November 15 inclusive and November 16, 1906 is the first civil date without that scheduling permission. This observation does not approve a replacement claim or establish that a meeting occurred. The mechanical refusal is an additional, independent defect: all five cited source references lack raw_path, despite matching text pins. The separately rehashed raw PDF inspection does not repair the submitted claim.
inventory_review: Complete target consists of one operative paragraph permitting one quarterly-session substitution, plus Roosevelt signature/title and September 20, 1906 White House date. No second command, recurring EO:506 schedule, appointment, report obligation, or independent continuing duty appears. The book prints no EO number; identity is a qualified date/subject/body/signature match with only the two allowed crosswalks.
effective_date_review: September 20, 1906 issuance; no delayed-effective clause. October 1 is the displaced session date, not a cessation date. November 15 is the permitted session day; close of that day, equivalently November 16 00:00, is the boundary of fresh date-substitution permission under the candidate theory. No fabricated administrative period is allowed.
first_ending_and_earlier_candidates: No meeting performance, actual convening, adjournment, completion or nonperformance was proved or inferred. Complete parent EO:317A, printed33-36/PDF46-49, provides quarterly dates and continuation of each session as public business requires. Thus the child permission does not impose adjournment at midnight. Nearby complete OCR pages90-92 supply only school/contingent/stamp appropriations, not an intervening session cancellation. OCR pages93-95 show a separate parent reorganization expressly effective November17,1906; that later event cannot move the specific November15 scheduling permission to November16 or make November17 its first exhaustion. Nearby OCR is a bounded lead, not an exhaustive legal search or separately page-verified later actor.
savings_review: A lawfully commenced session may continue under the parent, and historical validity and legal consequences of acts may remain. Those consequences are not a fresh EO:506 scheduling permission. Parent appointments, accounts, reports, contracts, departmental powers and its express preservation of consistent prior orders are separate parent provisions, not independent commands created by EO:506.
date_convention: Named November15 includes the full civil day. An exclusive interpretation ending at the start of November15 would exclude the expressly authorized day and is unsupported here. There is no literal until clause in this order.
